checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-NETWORK-CONNECT: Unauthenticated Network Connectivity Events
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set up a test DApp that connects to a provider via EIP-2786 connectivity events. 2. Simulate a MITM scenario where connect events carry a forged chainId. 3. Verify the DApp does NOT treat the connect event as an authenticated session. 4. Inject rapid connect/disconnect sequences to test that the DApp handles event storms without state corruption. 5. Confirm that disconnect events triggered by network manipulation propagate ProviderRpcError codes 4900/4901 correctly.
executable_checks: Assert that no authentication state is derived solely from connect/disconnect events
Assert that a forged chainId in a connect event does not cause the DApp to switch to an attacker-controlled chain without independent verification
Assert that rapid connect/disconnect cycling does not cause provider state machine to enter an undefined state
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2786-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-NETWORK-CONNECT from EXT-ETHEREUM-NETWORK to Execution Layer. Trust model indicates connect/disconnect events can be manipulated. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP2786-03.

checklist.title: Verify connection establishment does not assume event authenticity
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the ACTION-ESTABLISH-CONNECTION handler. 2. Verify it performs independent chain validation (e.g., eth_chainId RPC call) after receiving a connect event rather than trusting the event payload directly. 3. Confirm that ACTION-LOSE-CONNECTION does not leave stale authenticated state.
executable_checks: Assert that eth_chainId is called independently after connect event to verify chain identity
Assert that connection loss clears any cached chain identity
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2786-PRECOND-002. Supporting node check for boundary property. Covers nodes ACTION-ESTABLISH-CONNECTION, ACTION-LOSE-CONNECTION.

checklist.title: Falsify mutual exclusion of CONNECTED/DISCONNECTED provider states
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Initialize a provider instance. 2. Trigger concurrent connect and disconnect events in rapid succession. 3. After each event, query the provider state and assert it is in exactly one of CONNECTED or DISCONNECTED. 4. Attempt to invoke RPC methods while in DISCONNECTED state and verify they fail. 5. Attempt to transition directly from CONNECTED to CONNECTED (double connect) and verify the state machine handles it correctly.
executable_checks: Assert that at no point during testing does the provider report both CONNECTED and DISCONNECTED simultaneously
Assert that RPC requests are rejected when provider state is DISCONNECTED
Assert that duplicate connect events do not create an inconsistent state
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2786-INV-001. Invariant: provider must be in exactly one of two states. Testing via state transition violation attempts.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK: Future Slot Block Rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a beacon block with a slot value 1 greater than the current slot. 2. Submit it via the P2P gossip channel (EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK). 3. Verify the block is rejected before any state transition processing. 4. Test with slot = current_slot (should be accepted). 5. Test with slot = current_slot + 100 (extreme future) and confirm rejection. 6. Verify that temporal validation occurs before ancestry and finalization checks.
executable_checks: Assert that blocks with slot > current_slot are rejected
Assert that blocks with slot == current_slot are accepted (if other validations pass)
Assert that the rejection happens at the ACTION-VERIFY-TEMPORAL step
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CAPELLA-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK from EXT-PEER-P2P-BEACON. Trust model requires full block validation including temporal validity.

checklist.title: Verify temporal validation rejects future-slot blocks at boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that ACTION-VERIFY-TEMPORAL compares block.slot against the current slot derived from the system clock. 2. Test with a block whose slot is exactly at the boundary (current_slot). 3. Verify clock skew handling: if the node's clock is behind, does it incorrectly accept future blocks?
executable_checks: Assert that temporal check uses a consistent time source
Assert that clock skew tolerance is bounded and documented
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CAPELLA-PRECOND-002. Supporting node check for ACTION-VERIFY-TEMPORAL.

checklist.title: Falsify Capella post-merge assumption by submitting pre-merge block
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block without an execution payload (pre-merge format). 2. Submit it to a Capella-era fork choice handler. 3. Verify it is rejected as invalid without attempting merge transition verification. 4. Confirm that no code path exists that would accept a block without execution payload during Capella.
executable_checks: Assert that blocks without execution payloads are rejected during Capella
Assert that no merge transition verification logic is invoked during Capella validation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CAPELLA-INV-001. Invariant: PoS merge is assumed complete during Capella. Related: AMB-CAPELLA-FC-01, ASSUM-CAPELLA-FC-01.

checklist.title: Falsify EIP/RIP precompile address range disjointness invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all EIP precompile addresses (0x01-0xff) and all RIP precompile addresses (0x100-0x1ff). 2. Verify that no address appears in both ranges. 3. Test the address resolution logic with boundary values: 0xff (last EIP), 0x100 (first RIP), and 0x1ff (last RIP). 4. Attempt to register a precompile at address 0x100 as an EIP precompile and verify it is routed to RIP logic.
executable_checks: Assert that address 0xff resolves as EIP precompile
Assert that address 0x100 resolves as RIP precompile
Assert that the sets {0x01..0xff} and {0x100..0x1ff} have zero intersection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7587-INV-001. Invariant: EIP and RIP address ranges are strictly disjoint.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EL Engine API Response: Defensive IL Satisfaction Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate an EL that returns false for is_inclusion_list_satisfied when the block actually satisfies the inclusion list. 2. Verify the CL records the block as IL-unsatisfied and denies proposer boost. 3. Simulate an EL that returns true for a block that does NOT satisfy the inclusion list. 4. Verify the CL has secondary checks or at minimum logs the discrepancy. 5. Test with a censoring proposer scenario where the EL is complicit.
executable_checks: Assert that a false is_inclusion_list_satisfied response causes the block to be marked IL-unsatisfied
Assert that IL-unsatisfied blocks do not receive proposer boost
Assert that the CL does not blindly accept the EL response without recording it
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7805-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge from EL Engine API. Trust model: CL must handle EL responses defensively. Related: ASSUM-EIP7805FC-01.

checklist.title: Verify IL satisfaction recording is atomic and persistent
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger ACTION-RECORD-IL-SATISFACTION for a block. 2. Verify the result is stored in the fork choice store. 3. Restart the node and verify the IL satisfaction status persists. 4. Attempt to re-evaluate the same block's IL satisfaction and verify the cached result is used.
executable_checks: Assert that IL satisfaction results are persisted in the store
Assert that re-evaluation returns the cached result
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7805-PRECOND-002. Supporting node check for ACTION-RECORD-IL-SATISFACTION.

checklist.title: Falsify attester head downgrade when fork choice head is IL-unsatisfied
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set up a fork choice store where the head block is in unsatisfied_inclusion_list_blocks. 2. Call get_attester_head and verify it returns the parent block, not the head. 3. Call get_proposer_head and verify it allows reorging the IL-unsatisfied head. 4. Test edge case: what if the parent is also IL-unsatisfied? Verify cascading downgrade behavior.
executable_checks: Assert that get_attester_head returns parent when head is IL-unsatisfied
Assert that get_proposer_head permits reorg of IL-unsatisfied head
Assert that attesters never vote for an IL-unsatisfied block
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7805-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition: attesters vote for parent when head is IL-unsatisfied. Related: AMB-EIP7805FC-02, ASSUM-EIP7805FC-03.

checklist.title: Falsify resource limit enforcement on transaction monitoring subscriptions
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Open the maximum allowed number of eth_subscribe(transactionStatus) subscriptions from a single client. 2. Attempt to open one more and verify it is rejected. 3. Create a long-lived subscription and verify it is terminated after the maximum duration. 4. Measure memory consumption with many active subscriptions to verify bounded resource usage.
executable_checks: Assert that subscription count per client is bounded
Assert that subscriptions have a maximum lifetime
Assert that exceeding limits returns an appropriate JSON-RPC error
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP8072-PRECOND-003. Pre-condition: resource limits on subscriptions. Related: AMB-EIP8072-02.

checklist.title: Falsify finality notification delivery for monitored transactions
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Subscribe to transaction status for a known transaction. 2. Wait for the transaction to be included in a block. 3. Wait for the block to reach consensus-layer finality. 4. Verify a notification with status 'finalized' is sent containing the correct block details. 5. Test with a transaction that is reorged before finality and verify finalized notification is only sent after re-inclusion and finality.
executable_checks: Assert that 'finalized' notification is sent when the block reaches finality
Assert that 'finalized' notification contains correct block hash and receipt
Assert that no 'finalized' notification is sent for transactions whose blocks have not reached finality
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP8072-POSTCOND-004. Post-condition: finality notification delivery. Related: AMB-EIP8072-03.

checklist.title: Falsify PREVRANDAO opcode output in post-merge blocks
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that calls opcode 0x44 (PREVRANDAO) and returns the result. 2. Execute it in a post-merge block context. 3. Compare the returned value against the block header's mixHash field. 4. Verify the value is a full 256-bit value (not truncated). 5. Test across multiple blocks to confirm different RANDAO values are returned.
executable_checks: Assert that PREVRANDAO returns the exact 256-bit mixHash from the block header
Assert that the returned value is not zero (unless mixHash is genuinely zero)
Assert that different blocks produce different PREVRANDAO values
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4399-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition: EVM stack contains RANDAO mix after opcode 0x44 execution.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for CL-EL RANDAO Communication
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify the RANDAO mix is retrieved from the beacon chain via the Engine API (not computed locally by the EL). 2. Simulate a compromised CL that sends an incorrect RANDAO value. 3. Verify the EL uses the CL-provided value without independent verification (by design). 4. Document the trust assumption: EL trusts CL for RANDAO values. 5. Verify that the Engine API connection is JWT-authenticated.
executable_checks: Assert that the EL retrieves RANDAO from the CL via Engine API
Assert that the Engine API connection requires JWT authentication
Assert that the mixHash field in the block header matches the CL-provided RANDAO
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4399-PRECOND-002. Boundary: CL provides RANDAO to EL. Related: ASSUM-EIP4399-02.

checklist.title: Falsify client readiness invariant for Hegota upgrade
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the Hegota upgrade specification for the list of required client implementations. 2. Verify that each major client (Geth, Nethermind, Besu, Erigon, Reth for EL; Prysm, Lighthouse, Teku, Nimbus, Lodestar for CL) has implemented all required changes. 3. Run cross-client compatibility tests using the consensus test vectors. 4. Test with one client running old software at the activation timestamp and verify it forks off.
executable_checks: Assert that all major EL clients produce identical state roots for Hegota test vectors
Assert that all major CL clients produce identical beacon state for Hegota test vectors
Assert that a non-upgraded client is rejected by upgraded peers after activation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP8081-INV-001. Invariant: all clients must implement before activation. Related: ASSUM-EIP8081-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Gloas fork state transition: payload header replacement and builder registry
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Take a pre-Gloas beacon state snapshot. 2. Execute the Gloas fork upgrade function. 3. Verify latest_execution_payload_header field is removed from the post-state. 4. Verify latest_execution_payload_bid field exists and is correctly initialized. 5. Verify the builder registry is initialized with correct default values. 6. Verify all other beacon state fields are unchanged.
executable_checks: Assert that latest_execution_payload_header does not exist in post-Gloas state
Assert that latest_execution_payload_bid exists in post-Gloas state
Assert that builder registry is initialized and empty
Assert that all non-Gloas fields are byte-identical before and after upgrade
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-GLOAS-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition: payload header replaced, builder registry initialized. Related: ASSUM-GLOAS-FORK-02.

checklist.title: Falsify Gloas fork payment and withdrawal queue initialization
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute the Gloas fork upgrade. 2. Verify builder_pending_payments has exactly 2 * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries. 3. Verify each entry is initialized to the correct default value (zero/empty). 4. Verify builder_pending_withdrawals is initialized and ready for tracking. 5. Attempt to process a payment immediately after fork and verify the queue handles it correctly.
executable_checks: Assert that len(builder_pending_payments) == 2 * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH
Assert that all initial payment entries are zero-valued
Assert that builder_pending_withdrawals is initialized
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-GLOAS-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition: payment and withdrawal queues initialized at fork.

checklist.title: Falsify Prometheus metrics response completeness
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Register multiple metrics (ethereum_blockchain_height, ethereum_best_known_block_number, ethereum_peer_count). 2. Trigger a Prometheus scrape request. 3. Parse the response and verify all registered metrics are present. 4. Verify the response uses correct Prometheus exposition format (metric name, optional labels, value). 5. Verify that the response reflects current values (not stale cached values).
executable_checks: Assert that all registered metrics appear in the scrape response
Assert that the response parses correctly as Prometheus exposition format
Assert that metric values are current (within one block of latest)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2159-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition: metrics response completeness.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VOLUNTARY-EXIT-SUBMITTED: BLS Signature Verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a voluntary exit with a valid BLS signature under the Capella signing domain. Verify it is accepted. 2. Submit a voluntary exit with a valid BLS signature under a non-Capella fork domain. Verify it is rejected. 3. Submit a voluntary exit with an invalid BLS signature (corrupted). Verify rejection. 4. Submit a voluntary exit with a signature from a different validator's key. Verify rejection. 5. Verify the signing domain is computed using CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION specifically.
executable_checks: Assert that exits signed with CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION domain are accepted
Assert that exits signed with any other fork version domain are rejected
Assert that exits with invalid BLS signatures are rejected
Assert that exits signed by wrong validator key are rejected
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7044-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge EDGE-VOLUNTARY-EXIT-SUBMITTED. Trust model: signature must be verified against fixed Capella domain.

checklist.title: Verify signature validation uses Capella domain exclusively
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace ACTION-VALIDATE-EXIT-SIGNATURE implementation. 2. Verify the domain computation uses CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION hardcoded, not the current fork version. 3. Test at a future fork (e.g., Deneb, Electra) and verify the Capella domain is still used.
executable_checks: Assert that the signing domain in exit verification is always Capella regardless of current fork
Assert that STATE-SIGNATURE-VALID is only reached with Capella-domain signatures
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7044-PRECOND-003. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-EXIT-SIGNATURE.

checklist.title: Falsify tooling domain usage for voluntary exit signature generation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Use a reference wallet/tooling to generate a voluntary exit signature. 2. Verify the signing domain used is CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION. 3. Attempt to submit a signature generated with the current fork version (non-Capella) and verify it fails verification on-chain. 4. Test with multiple tooling implementations.
executable_checks: Assert that reference tooling uses CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION for exit signing
Assert that exits signed with non-Capella domain fail on-chain verification
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7044-PRECOND-004. Pre-condition: tooling must use Capella domain. Related: ASSUM-EIP7044-02.

checklist.title: Falsify deterministic execution root path selection based on epoch
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Test with a header at epoch = DENEB_FORK_EPOCH and verify the Deneb execution root computation path is selected. 2. Test with a header at epoch = CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH and verify the Capella path is selected. 3. Test with a header at epoch = CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH - 1 and verify the empty root path is selected. 4. Test at exact fork boundaries (DENEB_FORK_EPOCH - 1 vs DENEB_FORK_EPOCH). 5. Verify no off-by-one errors in epoch comparison.
executable_checks: Assert that epoch >= DENEB_FORK_EPOCH selects Deneb path
Assert that CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH <= epoch < DENEB_FORK_EPOCH selects Capella path
Assert that epoch < CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH selects empty root path
Assert that boundary epochs are handled correctly (no off-by-one)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-DENEB-LC-INV-001. Invariant: deterministic path selection by epoch. Related: AMB-DENEB-LC-SYNC-02.

checklist.title: Falsify minimum blob base fee floor enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute the blob base fee with excess_blob_gas = 0 (minimum scenario). 2. Verify the result is >= MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS (2^25 = 33,554,432 wei). 3. Simulate conditions where the exponential formula would produce a value below MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS and verify the floor is applied. 4. Test with very large excess_blob_gas values to ensure no overflow that could bypass the floor.
executable_checks: Assert that blob base fee is always >= 33,554,432 wei after EIP-7762 activation
Assert that the min floor is applied when the exponential formula produces a lower value
Assert that no integer overflow bypasses the floor check
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7762-INV-001. Invariant: blob base fee >= MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS. Related: ASSUM-EIP7762-03.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for BLAKE2 Precompile: Final Flag Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call the BLAKE2 F precompile with byte 212 set to 0x00. Verify success. 2. Call with byte 212 set to 0x01. Verify success. 3. Call with byte 212 set to 0x02. Verify the call fails. 4. Call with byte 212 set to 0xff. Verify the call fails. 5. Verify the failure mode is a precompile error (not out-of-gas).
executable_checks: Assert that f=0x00 produces valid output
Assert that f=0x01 produces valid output
Assert that f=0x02 causes precompile failure
Assert that f=0xff causes precompile failure
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP152-PRECOND-002. Boundary: caller-controlled input to precompile. Trust model: all input fields are attacker-controlled. Related: AMB-EIP152-01.

checklist.title: Verify final flag boolean validation is strict
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify the implementation checks f == 0 || f == 1 exactly, not f != 0 (which would accept 0x02-0xff as true). 2. Review the code path for ACTION-VALIDATE-FINAL-BOOLEAN to ensure strict comparison.
executable_checks: Assert that the validation is exact equality check (0 or 1), not truthiness check
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP152-PRECOND-002. Supporting node check for boolean validation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-EL-TO-CL-ACCESS-LIST-ROOT: Fork Transition Initialization
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. At the EIP-7928 fork transition, verify block_access_list_root in ExecutionPayloadHeader is initialized to Root() (32 zero bytes). 2. Post-fork, submit a block with EL-provided block_access_list_root and verify the CL validates it. 3. Submit a block with an incorrect block_access_list_root and verify rejection. 4. Test at the exact fork boundary block.
executable_checks: Assert that block_access_list_root == Root() at fork transition
Assert that post-fork, EL-provided values are validated by CL
Assert that inconsistent block_access_list_root causes block rejection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7928-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-EL-TO-CL-ACCESS-LIST-ROOT. Trust model: CL must validate EL-provided values. Related: AMB-EIP7928-02.

checklist.title: Falsify sequential fork ordering invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify the fork schedule configuration enforces Phase0 < Altair < Bellatrix < Capella < Deneb < Electra < Fulu epoch ordering. 2. Attempt to configure a fork schedule where Deneb activates before Capella and verify it is rejected. 3. Attempt to skip a fork (e.g., activate Electra without Deneb) and verify rejection. 4. Verify that all upgrade functions check the previous fork version matches expectations.
executable_checks: Assert that fork epochs are strictly increasing
Assert that skipping a fork in configuration is rejected
Assert that each upgrade function validates the previous fork version
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CONSPEC-INV-001. Invariant: strict sequential fork ordering. Related: ASSUM-CONSENSUSSPECS-02.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-DAPP-ABI-TO-WALLET: Case-Sensitive Address Matching
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a transaction with an ABI interface specification where the contract address uses lowercase hex. 2. Set the call target to the same address but with mixed-case (EIP-55 checksum). 3. Verify the wallet rejects the ABI match due to case mismatch. 4. Submit with exactly matching case and verify the ABI is applied. 5. Test with all-uppercase vs all-lowercase variations.
executable_checks: Assert that case-mismatched addresses prevent ABI application
Assert that case-matched addresses allow ABI application
Assert that the comparison is byte-exact string comparison
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7896-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-DAPP-ABI-TO-WALLET. Trust model: DApp ABIs are untrusted, case-sensitive matching required. Related: AMB-EIP7896-03.

checklist.title: Falsify calldata decoding accuracy against ABI definition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide a known ABI definition and corresponding calldata. 2. Execute ACTION-DECODE-CALLDATA. 3. Verify the decoded function name matches the ABI. 4. Verify all decoded parameters match expected values. 5. Test with edge cases: empty calldata, calldata shorter than 4 bytes (no function selector), and calldata with extra padding.
executable_checks: Assert that decoded function name matches the ABI definition
Assert that decoded parameter values match expected values
Assert that the wallet indicates whether the ABI was verified against a trusted source
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7896-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition: decoded calldata accuracy.

checklist.title: Falsify transient storage rollback on call frame revert
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract A that calls TSTORE to write a value, then calls contract B. 2. Have contract B call TSTORE to write a different value to the same key, then REVERT. 3. After B reverts, have A call TLOAD on the same key. 4. Verify the value is the one A wrote (B's write was rolled back). 5. Test nested reverts: A -> B -> C where C reverts, verify B's state is preserved but C's is rolled back.
executable_checks: Assert that TLOAD after inner frame revert returns the pre-revert value
Assert that nested reverts correctly restore each frame's transient storage
Assert that successful inner frames preserve their TSTORE writes
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP1153-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition: transient storage rollback on revert.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CL-FORKCHOICE-TO-EL: ForkchoiceState Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send engine_forkchoiceUpdated with a headBlockHash referencing an unknown payload. Verify error -38002 is returned. 2. Send with safeBlockHash that is NOT an ancestor of headBlockHash. Verify error -38002. 3. Send with finalizedBlockHash inconsistent with the chain. Verify error -38002. 4. Send a valid forkchoiceUpdated and verify the canonical head, safe block, and finalized block are updated atomically.
executable_checks: Assert that unknown headBlockHash returns -38002
Assert that non-ancestor safeBlockHash returns -38002
Assert that inconsistent finalizedBlockHash returns -38002
Assert that valid updates atomically update head/safe/finalized references
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ENGAPI-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-CL-FORKCHOICE-TO-EL. Trust model: JWT required, ForkchoiceState must be validated.

checklist.title: Verify forkchoice state validation checks all three block references
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace ACTION-VALIDATE-FORKCHOICE-STATE implementation. 2. Verify it checks: (a) headBlockHash is known and valid, (b) safeBlockHash is ancestor of head, (c) finalizedBlockHash is consistent. 3. Verify all three checks must pass for the update to proceed.
executable_checks: Assert that all three block hash references are validated
Assert that partial validation failure (e.g., only head invalid) still returns error
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ENGAPI-PRECOND-002. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-FORKCHOICE-STATE.

checklist.title: Falsify Engine API error code consistency
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger each error condition and verify the correct error code is returned: -38001 (unknown payload), -38002 (invalid forkchoice state), -38003 (invalid payload attributes), -38004 (oversized request), -38005 (unsupported fork). 2. Verify error codes are not reused or swapped. 3. Verify error messages are informative and consistent.
executable_checks: Assert that unknown payload returns -38001
Assert that invalid forkchoice state returns -38002
Assert that invalid payload attributes returns -38003
Assert that oversized requests return -38004
Assert that unsupported fork returns -38005
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ENGAPI-INV-001. Invariant: consistent error code usage across Engine API.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-REQRESP-DATA-COLUMN: Range Request Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a DataColumnSidecarsByRange request with valid start_slot and count within data_column_serve_range. Verify success. 2. Send a request with count exceeding MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB. Verify rejection. 3. Send a request with start_slot before the minimum serve range. Verify ResourceUnavailable (error 3). 4. Send a request with start_slot + count overflowing. Verify rejection. 5. Verify rate limiting is applied to prevent request flooding.
executable_checks: Assert that oversized requests (count > MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB) are rejected
Assert that out-of-range requests return ResourceUnavailable (error code 3)
Assert that integer overflow in start_slot + count is handled safely
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULU-P2P-PRECOND-004. Boundary edge EDGE-REQRESP-DATA-COLUMN. Trust model: request parameters must be validated. Related: AMB-FULU-P2P-03.

checklist.title: Verify range request validation is complete
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace ACTION-VALIDATE-RANGE-REQUEST. 2. Verify it checks: (a) count <= MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB, (b) start_slot within data_column_serve_range, (c) no integer overflow. 3. Verify rejection uses correct error codes.
executable_checks: Assert that all three validation checks are performed
Assert that validation order prevents short-circuit bypass
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULU-P2P-PRECOND-004. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-RANGE-REQUEST.

checklist.title: Falsify ENR field completeness after node startup
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Start a Fulu-compatible node. 2. Read the published ENR. 3. Verify the cgc (custody group count) field is present and matches the node's configured custody groups. 4. Verify the nfd (next fork digest) field is present. 5. Verify the eth2 field contains blob-parameter-aware fork digest. 6. Test with a supernode configuration and verify cgc reflects all 128 subnets.
executable_checks: Assert that ENR contains cgc field with correct value
Assert that ENR contains nfd field
Assert that ENR eth2 field includes blob-parameter-aware fork digest
Assert that supernode ENR has cgc reflecting all subnets
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULU-P2P-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition: ENR field completeness after startup.
